name: Escalation Assist
description: A support escalation agent for post-merger organizations. Combines customer context from your Microsoft 365 work data (Work IQ) with the acquired company's product engineering knowledge base (Foundry IQ on Azure AI Search), hosted in a different Microsoft Entra directory.

disclaimer.text: This declarative agent is provided as is without warranty of any kind, either express or implied, including any implied warranties of fitness for a particular purpose, merchantability, or non-infringement.

conversation_starters.title: Prepare an escalation
conversation_starters.text: A customer emailed me about their sync client failing after the latest update. Gather the email thread and check the product knowledge base for known issues and fixes.

conversation_starters.title: Known issue lookup
conversation_starters.text: Search the product engineering knowledge base: is there a known issue with authentication timeouts in the gateway component?

conversation_starters.title: Customer context
conversation_starters.text: Summarize all recent emails, Teams messages, and shared documents about the Northwind escalation

conversation_starters.title: Draft a response
conversation_starters.text: Draft a reply to the customer combining what engineering's knowledge base says about this error with the history from my email thread

conversation_starters.title: Who can help
conversation_starters.text: Who in my organization has been involved in escalations about the reporting module?
